source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: The interesting thing about able-adjectives is that they can be derived from transitive verbs (e.g. tuluj ‘endure’, kör ‘see’, bul ‘find’, ihit ‘listen, obey’ in (53)) in which case they preserve the internal argument of the base verb along with accusative case. This proves once again that syntactic processes of category change, unlike lexical ones, are incapable of affecting the original argument structure of the derivational base.
